gen-dafont-nulshock-fs-public-sans: Stretched wide with generous tracking, Nulshock traces a single unshaded outline. Public Sans brings a hefty, broad-mouthed lowercase that keeps long text sturdy and quick to move through.
gen-dafont-starborn-work-sans: Work Sans reads with a skimming ease, its weight never changing and its mean line set high. Starborn sprawls above it, all dreamy gaps and one dark lowercase stripe.
gen-dafont-stencilia-fs-fira-sans: Stencilia is structural and striking, with spacious gaps at its curve terminals. Fira Sans carries the reading, its s curves opening generously and its x-height running large, which keeps paragraphs steady and unfussy.
gen-dafont-stentiga-fs-epilogue: Spread-out tracking gives Stentiga a refined, luxurious look, with crossbars matching the stems and openings left ajar. Epilogue runs curvy and monoline, so text feels loose and friendly.
gen-dafont-galaxy-manrope: Galaxy is dense and cosmic, its loose letterfit leaving plenty of breathing space. Manrope reads bright and approachable, each curve opening at the mouth with barely any step from capitals to lowercase.
gen-dafont-joystix-work-sans: Pure arcade: Joystix is widely tracked, its stems only a shade heavier than their arms, so weight shimmers across each word. Work Sans stays smooth beneath it, with no brush-like swelling.
gen-dafont-origami-switzer: Sign-painter feel: Origami is a single brush stroke at constant width, massed like poured lead type. Switzer is the wire-like counterweight, tubular with a tall waist line and c tips that never close in.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-fs-fira-sans: Far-apart letters, each a constant-width outline you could trace with a fingertip, make Outrun Future unmistakable. Fira Sans handles the text; the heading earns its keep big and brief.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-fs-bespoke-sans: Bruno Ace SC strings its open-mouthed letters out like beads on a long thread, with no calligraphic thinning. Bespoke Sans adds sharp, refined space between curve ends and stems.
gen-dafont-quantum-fs-asap: Light-looking but never thinning, Quantum catches the eye with loose spacing and compressed ascenders. Asap takes the reading, with open c arcs and a body height nearly matching the capitals.
